about: Executable leaves of features/data-sync/scenario-tree.md, answered by the PRD of PR 235 (owner, 2026-10-18 to 2026-10-20). Fictional study fixtures; Android and backend interface details remain to be verified.

tree.label: Saved work lists tasks while offline

children.label: Study fixture: scenario=offline
Saved work lists tasks while offline

gwt.given: A worker has records saved on this phone and no connection.
gwt.then: Each task with records waiting is one row with its count, under Waiting to upload.

authority.says: Each task with records waiting is one row with its count, under Waiting to upload.

tree.label: Nothing waiting says everything has uploaded

children.label: Study fixture: scenario=done
Nothing waiting says everything has uploaded

gwt.given: Every record on this phone has uploaded.
gwt.then: One line says everything has uploaded.

authority.says: One line says everything has uploaded.

tree.label: A returning connection starts the upload

children.label: Study fixture: scenario=offline
The connection returns.
A returning connection starts the upload

gwt.given: Records are waiting with no connection.
gwt.then: Saved work says Uploading without anything to press.

authority.says: Saved work says Uploading without anything to press.

tree.label: Records settle one by one

children.label: Study fixture: scenario=partial
Records settle one by one

gwt.given: Some records have uploaded and some have not.
gwt.then: Only tasks still holding records are listed, each with what is left, and a task with records not accepted says so.

authority.says: Only tasks still holding records are listed, each with what is left, and a task with records not accepted says so.

tree.label: A refused record shows its reason, read only

children.label: Study fixture: scenario=offline&taskId=preg31
The worker opens Not accepted from the task.
A refused record shows its reason, read only

gwt.given: The server refused a record and another person recorded a sow first.
gwt.when: The worker opens Not accepted from the task.
gwt.then: Each record shows what the farm kept or why it was refused; nothing asks for an action.

authority.says: Each record shows what the farm kept or why it was refused; nothing asks for an action.

text.en: Sow 000267 had already left the unit
text.zh: 母猪 000267 已离开该单元

tree.label: Not accepted records offer no delete

children.label: Study fixture: scenario=offline&taskId=preg31
The worker opens Not accepted.
Not accepted records offer no delete

gwt.given: A record was not accepted.
gwt.then: There is no Delete or Discard: the record is information only.

authority.says: There is no Delete or Discard: the record is information only.

tree.label: A not accepted record stays readable

children.label: Study fixture: scenario=offline&taskId=preg31
The worker opens Not accepted.
A not accepted record stays readable

gwt.given: Another person recorded sow 000412 first.
gwt.then: The record stays listed with the farm's value; there is no retry.

authority.says: The record stays listed with the farm's value; there is no retry.

tree.label: A record waiting on an earlier one is an ordinary entry

children.label: Study fixture: scenario=offline&taskId=preg31
A record waiting on an earlier one is an ordinary entry

gwt.given: A later record on sow 000308 waits for an earlier one.
gwt.then: It is listed like any other record, with no blocked state.

authority.says: It is listed like any other record, with no blocked state.

tree.label: Switching farm is stopped while records wait

children.label: Study fixture: scenario=switch
Switching farm is stopped while records wait

gwt.given: Records are still on this phone.
gwt.when: The worker tries to switch farm.
gwt.then: Upload first stops the switch and names the farm.

authority.says: Upload first stops the switch and names the farm.

tree.label: The team's record is kept and shown first

children.label: Study fixture: scenario=offline&taskId=preg31
They open Not accepted.
The team's record is kept and shown first

gwt.given: The worker recorded Pregnant, and another person had recorded Not pregnant first.
gwt.then: The farm's value leads; theirs is the line under it.

authority.says: The farm's value leads; theirs is the line under it.

tree.label: A later record isn't held back by one that wasn't accepted

children.label: Study fixture: scenario=offline&taskId=preg31
A later record isn't held back by one that wasn't accepted

gwt.given: A check on sow 000412 was not accepted, and a recheck was saved after it.
gwt.then: The recheck waits as an ordinary record and uploads on its own; nothing is blocked or deleted.

authority.says: The recheck waits as an ordinary record and uploads on its own; nothing is blocked or deleted.

tree.label: Nothing in Not accepted is deleted

children.label: Study fixture: scenario=offline&taskId=preg31
The worker reads Not accepted.
Nothing in Not accepted is deleted

gwt.given: Records were not accepted.
gwt.then: No record is deleted or discarded there.

authority.says: No record is deleted or discarded there.

tree.label: Signing back in as the same person resumes uploads

children.label: Study fixture: scenario=expired
The worker signs in again as G. Hansen.

text.en: Your records are safe on this phone
text.zh: 记录已安全保存在本机

children.label: Signing back in as the same person resumes uploads

gwt.given: The sign-in expired with records on this phone.
gwt.when: The worker signs in again as G. Hansen.
gwt.then: Uploads resume and the sign-in bar goes.

authority.says: Uploads resume and the sign-in bar goes.

tree.label: A record whose receipt is being checked shows as uploading

children.label: Study fixture: scenario=uncertain
A record whose receipt is being checked shows as uploading

gwt.given: A record reached the server but the phone lost the reply.
gwt.then: It counts as uploading; no checking state is shown.

authority.says: It counts as uploading; no checking state is shown.

tree.label: Home's icon opens Saved work

children.label: Home fixture: offline
The worker taps the header's saved-work icon on the toolbox page.
Home's icon opens Saved work

gwt.given: Records wait on this phone while another page is open.
gwt.when: The worker taps the header's saved-work control.
gwt.then: Saved work lists the tasks still holding records.

authority.says: Saved work lists the tasks still holding records.

tree.label: The header's saved-work icon stays quiet while records upload

children.label: Home fixture: connection restored
The worker checks the toolbox while upload is active.
The header's saved-work icon stays quiet while records upload

gwt.given: Records on this phone are uploading automatically.
gwt.when: The worker checks the toolbox page.
gwt.then: The header shows the saved-work icon alone, with no number and no uploading form; it still opens Saved work.

authority.at: Decisions 2026-10-18 (owner): Home's header shows the icon alone; the tiles carry the counts (PR 235)
authority.says: The saved-work control is the icon alone, quiet, while records are on this phone; red only when signed out.

tree.label: A task with records not accepted says so

children.label: Home fixture: upload failed
The worker opens Saved work from the header's icon on another page.
A task with records not accepted says so

gwt.given: Some records were not accepted.
gwt.when: The worker opens Saved work from the header.
gwt.then: The task with records not accepted says so on its row.

authority.says: The task with records not accepted says so on its row.

tree.label: Many records are one log, not categories

children.label: Study fixture: scenario=offline&taskId=preg31
Many records are one log, not categories

gwt.given: A task has records in several units.
gwt.then: They see one log with the unit switch; there is no category layer.

authority.says: They see one log with the unit switch; there is no category layer.

tree.label: Past uploads sit behind the clock

children.label: Study fixture: scenario=syncing
The worker taps the clock on Saved work.
Past uploads sit behind the clock

gwt.given: Records uploaded over the last days.
gwt.when: The worker taps the clock on Saved work.
gwt.then: Past uploads opens, by day, for the last 30 days on this phone.

authority.says: Past uploads opens, by day, for the last 30 days on this phone.

tree.label: A task's badge opens that task's records

children.label: Study fixture: Farrowing task has two pending records and this phone has three
The worker opens the task header badge.
A task's badge opens that task's records

gwt.given: Farrowing has two records on this phone.
gwt.when: The worker taps the task's badge.
gwt.then: Farrowing's own records open with the unit switch; no other task's records are listed.

authority.says: Farrowing's own records open with the unit switch; no other task's records are listed.

tree.label: A task's records have no link to the whole phone

children.label: Study fixture: scenario=offline&taskId=farrow28&from=task
A task's records have no link to the whole phone

gwt.given: The worker opened Farrowing's records from its badge.
gwt.then: It shows this task with the unit switch; the whole phone is Home's, not a link here.

authority.says: It shows this task with the unit switch; the whole phone is Home's, not a link here.

tree.label: The task's badge stays on the page under a sow's drawer

children.label: Farrowing task has two waiting records
Open a sow from the task list
The task's badge stays on the page under a sow's drawer

gwt.given: Farrowing task 28 has two records on this phone.
gwt.when: The worker opens a sow's drawer from the task list.
gwt.then: The task page under the drawer keeps its badge with the task's count, 2; no 'Task 2' word.

authority.at: Decisions 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-18 (owner): a task's badge is an upload icon and that task's record count; none when the task has none (PR 235)
authority.says: Every page of the task carries the same badge, the task's record count.

tree.label: A task with no records of its own shows no badge

children.label: No Farrowing record, records from other tasks on the phone
A task with no records of its own shows no badge

gwt.given: This Farrowing task has nothing on the phone, while other tasks do.
gwt.when: The worker reads the task page.
gwt.then: There is no badge in its header; Home holds the phone's records.

authority.at: Decisions 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-18 (owner): a task's badge is an upload icon and that task's record count; none when the task has none (PR 235)
authority.says: A task's badge counts only its own records and is absent when it has none.

tree.label: From Home into a task with none of its own: no badge

children.label: Home has three Gestation records, Farrowing has none
Open the Farrowing task card from Home
From Home into a task with none of its own: no badge

gwt.given: Home has records from other work and the Farrowing task has none.
gwt.when: The worker enters the Farrowing task from Home.
gwt.then: The task page shows no badge; Home's icon holds the phone's records.

authority.at: Decisions 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-18 (owner): a task's badge is an upload icon and that task's record count; none when the task has none (PR 235)
authority.says: A task's badge counts only its own records and is absent when it has none.
